Has one root node, and each node can have child nodes. 용어정리 Node : The node stores the data along with the links to other nodes. Edge : The edge connects two nodes (parent-to-child) of a tree. Parent & Child : If there is an edge from P to Q, P is a Parent of Q, and Q is a Child of P. Siblings : Nodes that have the same parent (e.g., E and F are siblings) Root : The first node of the tree without any parents (e.g., node A) Leaf & Internal : If P has no children, P is a Leaf node. Otherwise, it is an Internal node. 자식이 BOA leaf 노드, leaf 노드가 OFL|A Internal 노드빨간색 Internal 파란색 leaf Path : A sequence of nodes from the start to destination.
